tool_input.command: git stash && bun test 2>&1 | tail -40; git stash pop

result:
No failures (warnings are pre-existing and unrelated). Everything checks out.

I fixed `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`'s `update()` method, which previously bypassed both validation and mass-assignment protection by calling `Post.forceUpdate({ id: post.id }, await this.request.json())` — a client could send any field, including `authorId`, and it would be written directly. It now calls `this.validateBody(PostPayloadSchema)` (the same schema `store()` uses, enforcing required `title`/`excerpt`/`body` with the same length limits) and passes the validated data to the fillable-checked `Post.update()` instead of `forceUpdate()`; since `authorId` isn't in `Post.fillable`, it can never be set from request input regardless of what a client sends. I added `tests/PostController.update.test.ts` covering: author cannot be reassigned via the body, extraneous fields (e.g. `createdAt`) aren't persisted, an empty title is rejected with 422 and leaves the post unchanged, non-authors get 403 without any mutation, and a normal author edit still succeeds. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (7/7 passing), and `bunx guren check` all pass clean.
